title: Sordland/Turn01/Personal_Ball
description: The famous victory ball is held. The President and his family set out from home to the very steps of the Palace to join the ball there. Many interactions are made with Monica to highlight the current relationship between husband and wife. Additional moments are had between the  Player and Deana and Franc as well as Petr Vectern and Evelyn Vectern.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had just finished buttoning up my..."
entries.dialogueText: I had just finished buttoning up my suit jacket when the doorbell rang. The Presidential Guard had arrived to pick us up for the inaugural ball.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The ball was a three-decade-old tra..."
entries.dialogueText: The ball was a three-decade-old tradition, breathlessly anticipated by politicians, bureaucrats and the press. All eyes were about to be on me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My guards fended most of them off,..."
entries.dialogueText: My guards fended most of them off, but one woman managed to dodge them and corner me. I recognized the Sordish Broadcasting Company logo on her press lanyard.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If the opposition is willing to su..."
entries.dialogueText: “If the opposition is willing to support us.”
entries.menuText: “If the opposition is willing to support us.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“My administration will bring real..."
entries.dialogueText: “My administration will bring real change.”
entries.menuText: “My administration will bring real change.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This night is for celebration. I’m..."
entries.dialogueText: “This night is for celebration. I’m not going to talk about my policies now.”
entries.menuText: “This night is for celebration. I’m not going to talk about my policies now.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We are going to work with everybod..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are going to work with everybody.”
entries.menuText: “We are going to work with everybody.”

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: "“Do you plan on working together wi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Do you plan on working together with the opposition parties on the expected constitutional reforms?”

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: "“Does that mean you don’t plan on w..."
entries.dialogueText: “Does that mean you don’t plan on working together? Do you think you share no common ground with the other parties?”

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: "“Mr. Ricter clarified that as long..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Ricter clarified that as long as you hold your promises of democratization, they will support you on these issues to the end. What do you think about this statement?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I did not say that.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I did not say that.”
entries.menuText: “I did not say that.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We will do our job, no matter what..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will do our job, no matter what."
entries.menuText: “We will do our job, no matter what.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don’t think the opposition share..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don’t think the opposition shares our values, no."
entries.menuText: “I don’t think the opposition shares our values, no.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No comment, sorry.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No comment, sorry.”
entries.menuText: "No comment, sorry."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I welcome it. This is a challenge..."
entries.dialogueText: “I welcome it. This is a challenge for us all.”
entries.menuText: “I welcome it. This is a challenge for us all.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We want the other parties to join..."
entries.dialogueText: “We want the other parties to join him in this endeavor.”
entries.menuText: “We want the other parties to join him in this endeavor.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Honestly, I don’t expect much from..."
entries.dialogueText: “Honestly, I don’t expect much from him.”
entries.menuText: “Honestly, I don’t expect much from him.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I can’t comment since I haven’t se..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can’t comment since I haven’t seen his statement yet.”
entries.menuText: “I can’t comment since I haven’t seen his statement yet.”

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""One more question. One of your fir..."
entries.dialogueText: "One more question. One of your first acts as president was to sign a campaign finance law allocating public election funds by seats in the Assembly as opposed to number of votes. Is this a deliberate attempt to defund the Communist Party and the Bludia Workers' Party, neither of which have reached the election threshold?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "“That’s enough, ma'am,” said one of..."
entries.dialogueText: “That’s enough, ma'am,” said one of my guards while nudging the reporter away from me. A path through the crowd was now open, and we quickly made our way to the entrance of the palace. At the same time, a dozen fireworks went off.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The entrance was decorated with bea..."
entries.dialogueText: The entrance was decorated with beautiful ribbons in Sordland’s colors of white, yellow and maroon. A lush maroon carpet had been rolled down the stairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered the lobby and joined the..."
entries.dialogueText: We entered the lobby and joined the throngs of people making their way towards the ballroom.

entries.title: Deana: "“Uncle Petr!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Uncle Petr!”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Hi, Uncle Petr. It's great to see..."
entries.dialogueText: “Hi, Uncle Petr. It's great to see you."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“There they are, the most beautiful..."
entries.dialogueText: “There they are, the most beautiful family in Sordland!”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“Congratulations, Anton. I have to..."
entries.dialogueText: “Congratulations, Anton. I have to say, the results were clear to me from the beginning.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“You two are growing faster than I..."
entries.dialogueText: “You two are growing faster than I am getting wiser!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are you sure you've gotten any wis..."
entries.dialogueText: “Are you sure you've gotten any wiser, Petr?”
entries.menuText: “Are you sure you've gotten any wiser, Petr?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You're a sight for sore eyes, Petr..."
entries.dialogueText: “You're a sight for sore eyes, Petr.”
entries.menuText: “You're a sight for sore eyes, Petr.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Mr. Vice President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Vice President.”
entries.menuText: “Mr. Vice President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Inside, we were yet again surrounde..."
entries.dialogueText: Inside, we were yet again surrounded by a noisy crowd – but this time, it was the politicians who sought to appease the new authority in Sordland.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr's wife Evelyn approached us an..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr's wife Evelyn approached us and shook our hands with a firmness that belied her delicate features.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Appreciated, Evelyn. It means a lo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Appreciated, Evelyn. It means a lot.”
entries.menuText: “Appreciated, Evelyn. It means a lot.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I wish I was as sure as you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I wish I was as sure as you.”
entries.menuText: “I wish I was as sure as you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“There's a woman behind every succe..."
entries.dialogueText: “There's a woman behind every successful man.”
entries.menuText: “There's a woman behind every successful man.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you. We both worked hard to..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you. We both worked hard to make it happen.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you. We both worked hard to make it happen.”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“Monica, how are you? You've barely..."
entries.dialogueText: “Monica, how are you? You've barely said a word."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""And tonight, we reap the rewards!""
entries.dialogueText: "And tonight, we reap the rewards!"

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“What a gentleman.”"
entries.dialogueText: “What a gentleman.”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“The pleasure is mine.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The pleasure is mine.”

entries.speaker: Deana

entries.dialogueText: “Papa, can we go? I want to see the ballroom!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes, it's time. Let's go.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, it's time. Let's go.”
entries.menuText: “Yes, it's time. Let's go.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Of course, my darling. Let's not d..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course, my darling. Let's not delay any longer.”
entries.menuText: “Of course, darling.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We left the lobby and made our way..."
entries.dialogueText: We left the lobby and made our way towards the ballroom.

entries.menuText: “I'll see you on the trip home.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Goodbye.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Goodbye.”
entries.menuText: “Goodbye.”

entries.dialogueText: I stepped out and immediately found myself surrounded by loud voices and camera flashes. Hordes of eager journalists thrust their portable microphones my way.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Politicians, bureaucrats and celebr..."
entries.dialogueText: Politicians, bureaucrats and celebrities -- the creme de la creme of the Sordland elite -- streamed inside the building.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Good luck out there, Mr. President..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good luck out there, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Maybe not. After all, I'm still st..."
entries.dialogueText: “Maybe not. After all, I'm still sticking with you."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Likewise.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Likewise.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern

entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Monica

entries.dialogueText: “Happy to see a familiar face, Petr. Evelyn!”

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: "“Mr. President! Mr. President!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President! Mr. President!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We are having a conversation here,..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are having a conversation here, Deana.”
entries.menuText: “We are having a conversation here, Deana.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned away in disappointment."
entries.dialogueText: She turned away in disappointment.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“That's all right, we need to go an..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's all right, we need to go anyway. It's already time.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Come now, you became the president..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come now, you became the president. You held fast against the party leadership and managed to win.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I respect that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I respect that."

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern

entries.dialogueText: “We know you did. You deserve the position.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern

entries.dialogueText: “I think it's time to celebrate this victory!"

entries.title: Player: "“Thank you, Petr.”"

entries.menuText: “Thank you, Petr.”

entries.menuText: “I couldn't have done it without you.”

entries.dialogueText: “Yes, I definitely need a celebration after all that.”

entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“I know you do.""
entries.dialogueText: “I know you do."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“You read my mind.""
entries.dialogueText: “You read my mind."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr grinned and beckoned a roving..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr grinned and beckoned a roving waiter. The four of us each took a glass of champagne.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Exactly, that's why we are here.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Exactly, that's why we are here.”
entries.menuText: “Exactly, that's why we are here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I hope you will show the same enth..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope you will show the same enthusiasm on the job.”
entries.menuText: “I hope you will show the same enthusiasm on the job.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave a short smile that looked h..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave a short smile that looked halfway genuine. He seemed uncomfortable.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“Of course I will! You know me -- I..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course I will! You know me -- I work as hard as I play."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Somebody had to do it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Somebody had to do it.”
entries.menuText: “Somebody had to do it.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You're right. I'm glad it was you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. I'm glad it was you is all."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "“We could start by getting some dri..."
entries.dialogueText: “We could start by getting some drinks.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica smiled at me."
entries.dialogueText: Monica smiled at me.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I only did my part, Anton. But, th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only did my part, Anton. But, thanks, that means a lot."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We finally settled down at our dinn..."
entries.dialogueText: We finally settled down at our dinner table with the Vecterns as the band started playing some slow jazz tunes.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Oof. That was tiring.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oof. That was tiring."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We have to get used to it.""
entries.dialogueText: “We have to get used to it."
entries.menuText: “We have to get used to it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“If I have to shake another hand ag..."
entries.dialogueText: “If I have to shake another hand again..."
entries.menuText: “If I have to shake another hand again..."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “What, you're already tired?"
entries.menuText: “What, you're already tired?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well-""
entries.dialogueText: "Well-"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, a loud banging noise echo..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, a loud banging noise echoed from outside the ballroom. Then another one. And another.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Another drink?""
entries.dialogueText: "Another drink?"
entries.menuText: “Another drink?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""I'm more than relieved to have thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm more than relieved to have this roller-coaster ride over with. But of course, now the real work begins...”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I called on Monica to get the child..."
entries.dialogueText: I called on Monica to get the children ready. Looking in the mirror, I straightened my tie and took a deep breath. After tonight, there would be no turning back.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I spent the next few hours shaking..."
entries.dialogueText: I spent the next few hours shaking hands, joining various conversations -- some serious, some superficial -- and making speeches.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The musicians stopped playing. Ever..."
entries.dialogueText: The musicians stopped playing. Everyone in the room was looking around in confusion.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Fireworks!?""
entries.dialogueText: "Fireworks!?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr and I turned towards each othe..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr and I turned towards each other, realization dawning on both of our faces.

entries.dialogueText: “Don't be so old-fashioned, Evelyn! I plan to use my power as First Lady to advance the position of women throughout Sordland. Equal rights for our sex are long overdue, wouldn't you say, Anton?"

entries.title: Bernard Circas: "“Perhaps now is the time that our l..."
entries.dialogueText: “Perhaps now is the time that our long-nurtured dream of revolution will finally become a reality.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Mr. Circas. Your congra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. Circas. Your congratulations are well received, despite our political differences."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A remarkable achievement, yes. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "A remarkable achievement, yes. But the true test begins now, don't you think?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I appreciate your congratulations...."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your congratulations. But from one former Red Youth member to another, we both know our work has just begun."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""President Rayne. You have no idea..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Rayne. You have no idea how happy it makes me to see a fellow Young Sord in the Maroon Palace."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""We sure have. But I still remember..."
entries.dialogueText: "We sure have. But I still remember them like they were yesterday."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Once a Young Sord, always a Young..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once a Young Sord, always a Young Sord. That's what I believe, anyway."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Mr. Holstron. Our share..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. Holstron. Our shared past binds us in this journey for a stronger Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We've come a long way from our You..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've come a long way from our Young Sords days, haven't we, Mr. Holstron?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Almost as happy as it makes me to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Almost as happy as it makes me to see a fellow Young Sord at this ball."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Navigating the sea of guests, I fou..."
entries.dialogueText: Navigating the sea of guests, I found myself face-to-face with a towering figure. Remus Holstron, the 'Iron Wall', former Young Sord, and a stalwart of the National Front Party.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I navigated through the crowd, a..."
entries.dialogueText: As I navigated through the crowd, a familiar figure stepped into my path. It was Bernard Circas -- the acclaimed poet and now MP. His face bore a look of subtle defiance.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Mr. Circas. We've both..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. Circas. We've both come a long way from our Red Youth days, haven't we?"

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""Correct, Mr. President. The real w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Correct, Mr. President. The real work begins now."

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""That's right, President Rayne. Onc..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's right, President Rayne. Once a Red Youth, always a Red Youth."

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""Yes, we have. But some things neve..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we have. But some things never change, do they?"

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: "“I can't help but wonder how the wi..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can't help but wonder how the winds of change will blow in our Sordland now that you've taken the helm.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Revolution, Mr. Circas? Let's hope..."
entries.dialogueText: "Revolution, Mr. Circas? Let's hope it's a peaceful one, for the sake of both Sordland and its new president."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You might be onto something, Berna..."
entries.dialogueText: "You might be onto something, Bernard. But tonight, let's put politics aside and enjoy the evening."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Revolution or not, Mr. Circas. It'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Revolution or not, Mr. Circas. It's a night of unity for Sordland. Let's celebrate that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sordland needs progress, not revol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland needs progress, not revolution. Any upheaval will endanger our chance for improvement."

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""You mustn't forget. To ride toward..."
entries.dialogueText: "You mustn't forget. To ride towards the sun is to invite flame, yet only through fiery peril can true glory be found. The light of it binds us all."

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""You're right. Tonight should be a..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. Tonight should be a celebration. But remember, to ride towards the sun is to invite flame, yet only through fiery peril can true glory be found. The light of it binds us all."

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""Unity is a rare beast, President R..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unity is a rare beast, President Rayne. Remember, to ride towards the sun is to invite flame, yet only through fiery peril can true glory be found. The light of it binds us all."

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""Remember, to ride towards the sun..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember, to ride towards the sun is to invite flame, yet only through fiery peril can true glory be found. The light of it binds us all."

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""That is the weight of your new rol..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is the weight of your new role."

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""Let's hope for the same for Sordla..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hope for the same for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""We will share this journey togethe..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will share this journey together."

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""Danger and progress... they might..."
entries.dialogueText: "Danger and progress... they might be more intertwined than you think."

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""I've taken up enough of your time,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've taken up enough of your time, President Rayne. This is your night, after all. Your family, friends, and country await."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks for sharing your wisdom, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for sharing your wisdom, Mr. Circas. Enjoy your evening."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Well said, Bernard. I'll see you i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well said, Bernard. I'll see you inside."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You certainly have a way with word..."
entries.dialogueText: "You certainly have a way with words, Mr. Circas. I see why they gave you the Vulpitzer Award."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Were they mere poetic expressions?..."
entries.dialogueText: Were they mere poetic expressions? Or a reflection of the real socialist sentiments stirring within the country?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I watched Bernard Circas blend b..."
entries.dialogueText: As I watched Bernard Circas blend back into the crowd, his words echoed in my mind.

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
entries.title: Bernard Circas: ""Until we meet again.""
entries.dialogueText: "Until we meet again."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I appreciate your sentiments, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your sentiments, Mr. Holstron. This triumph belongs to every Sordish citizen."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""I know every maroon-blooded Sord i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know every maroon-blooded Sord is rejoicing at your victory."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""From street brawls in Jen to hands..."
entries.dialogueText: "From street brawls in Jen to handshakes at the Maroon Palace."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""My time in the Young Sords taught..."
entries.dialogueText: "My time in the Young Sords taught me a lot about the true spirit of this nation. You too, I bet."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Think of Sordland like a piece of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think of Sordland like a piece of iron forged in fire. Strengthened by the flame of dedication and the hammer of order."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Nicely put, Mr. Holstron. Our shar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nicely put, Mr. Holstron. Our shared past and values will help in forging a strong Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't forget the importance of emb..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget the importance of embracing new ideals."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your emphasis on order and strengt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your emphasis on order and strength concerns me. We must not forget that democracy is the core of our nation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I appreciate your perspective, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your perspective, but I believe we need to balance strength with compassion to truly honor the spirit of Sordland."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Compassion won't help when the cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Compassion won't help when the country descends into chaos. Only a firm hand with an unyielding grip."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""I hope so. That weakling Alphonso..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope so. That weakling Alphonso knew nothing about the true nature of leadership."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""I beg to differ. Democracy isn't t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I beg to differ. Democracy isn't the core of our nation, Mr. President. It's something we copied from our neighbors."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""I'm all for new ideals, as long as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm all for new ideals, as long as we don't stray too far from the principles that have defined us."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Either way, it looks like both of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Either way, it looks like both of us have a busy term ahead of us. I've got a series of bills I'm working on to address the friction in our society."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Whether in 1866 or 1928, one thing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether in 1866 or 1928, one thing rings true. Without order, there is chaos."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""I heard about your promise to tigh..."
entries.dialogueText: "I heard about your promise to tighten Sordland's immigration laws, by the way."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""We can't let our culture and ident..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't let our culture and identity become diluted. Sordland for Sords, as they say."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I appreciate your support. Togethe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your support. Together, we will ensure the preservation of our Sordish identity."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The tightening of laws should be a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The tightening of laws should be aimed at preserving our nation's harmony, not fostering division."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, our immigration is sorely in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, our immigration is sorely in need of regulation. But we must remember our values of unity and compassion."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I disagree. Diversity fosters rich..."
entries.dialogueText: "I disagree. Diversity fosters richness in culture and ideas. Immigration will only strengthen Sordish identity."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Holstron, our nation has alway..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Holstron, our nation has always thrived by accepting others. We can't shy away from that now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I did not want to change too much..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not want to change too much too quickly. But I do agree with you. I'm looking to tighten those laws in the future."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Speaking of which, I heard you're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Speaking of which, I heard you're sticking with Alphonso's lax immigration laws? Surely that's not true."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""I'm glad you're as concerned about..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you're as concerned about preserving our nation's identity as I am."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""But tonight's a celebration, right..."
entries.dialogueText: "But tonight's a celebration, right? Time to show all the establishment politicians in the Palace how a real patriot lets loose."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, let's put aside politics for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, let's put aside politics for tonight. Enjoy the evening."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I fully intend to do so. Thanks fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I fully intend to do so. Thanks for the kind words."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We have a lot of work to do, Mr. H..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have a lot of work to do, Mr. Holstron. I look forward to seeing your proposals. Good evening."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A mirror to the nationalism still s..."
entries.dialogueText: A mirror to the nationalism still stirring within Sordland, he offered a potent reminder of the complexities and divisions that we would need to navigate in the days to come.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Remus Holstron disappeared back..."
entries.dialogueText: As Remus Holstron disappeared back into the crowd, his parting words resonated.

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""We'll speak soon. And remember, ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll speak soon. And remember, never lose sight of the iron cause."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Looking forward to it, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looking forward to it, Mr. President. Remember: One Sordland, One Nation, One Future."

entries.speaker: Remus Holstron
entries.title: Remus Holstron: ""Remember, Mr. President: One Sordl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember, Mr. President: One Sordland, One Nation, One Future."

entries.dialogueText: "Once a Young Sord, always a Young Sord. That's how I feel, anyway."

entries.speaker: Bernard Circas
